thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALARM: p99 latency spike + 5xx rate increase for /v1/generate across us-east-1 (alerts/redwood-prod)
incident-bot: Graph: https://infra.redwood.example/alerts/3181234567 (see dashboard)
sara: paging oncall now — I’m incoming, grabbing traces
mike: I can look at the deploy graph, which version rolled out?
sara: @deploy-bot what rolled at 11:40 UTC?
deploy-bot: Release 2026.03.15-11:40 (service: inference-gateway) deployed to prod/us-east-1 by jess
jess: confirmed, small canary then gradual rollout. No obvious failures in canary logs.
lee: seeing a ton of 504/gateway timeout spikes at the gateway layer, correlates with v2 model switch
sara: timeline check: p50 unchanged, p95 jumped ~2.1x, p99 jumped ~6x since 11:44
tasha: customer impact: some tenants report degraded responses and retries, CS tickets increasing (ref: https://support.redwood.example/ticket/8245)
mike: running quick query on backend pods: 
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=inference-runtime -o wide
# high CPU on pod runtime-7 and increased socket backlog
```
sara: can we route traffic to fallback model variant (v1-quant) while we triage? Need quick mitigation
jess: initiating soft-failover to fallback-model in us-east-1 now, 10% -> 50%
lee: adding extra 2 replicas to runtime pool and bumping gateway timeout to 45s for now
mike: I see increased KV-cache eviction rate after v2 rollout; possible KV cache size mismatch with new kernel selection
tasha: alerting enterprise customers in affected regions: short blurb ready for CS — "We're investigating increased timeouts; short-term mitigation in progress."
sara: still seeing 5xx (502/504) at the gateway after failover started, not decreasing yet
jess: I'm rolling back the 11:40 canary to previous stable tag across us-east-1 — starting rollback at 11:58 UTC
lee: logs from runtime-7 around 11:50: 
```
EPOCH 2026-03-15T11:50:12Z runtime: kv_cache: evict miss=1423 hit=12 size=8MB
EPOCH 2026-03-15T11:50:12Z runtime: kernel_select: selected quant-path but sequence_len=2048
EPOCH 2026-03-15T11:50:14Z runtime: request_handler: deadline exceeded
```
mike: that kernel/sequence mismatch could cause pathological scheduling; agree rollback is right move
sara: rollback finished at 12:02 UTC per deploy-bot, traffic stabilized to pre-rollout distribution
incident-bot: NOTE: Post-rollback metrics: p95 back within 10% of baseline, p99 trending down but still noisy
jess: will keep the canary blocked until root cause triaged. Opening an eval job to reproduce with long sequence inputs
tasha: CS update sent to affected customers at 12:10 UTC — promising initial stabilization
lee: creating a short-lived alert for KV cache eviction rate and kernel selection mismatch to catch possible re-introductions
mike: follow-up tasks: 1) add guard rails to kernel selection for long sequences, 2) run canary with synthetic high-seq traffic, 3) add rollout checklist item for kv cache sizing. I'll create tickets.
sara: oncall handoff: I’ll stay until 13:30 UTC to observe, then hand to @mike for triage deep-dive
jess: tagging this thread for incident review and postmortem. Assigning owners: mike (root cause), lee (runtime fix), jess (release gating), tasha (customer comms)
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-01, severity: SEV2, links: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-0315-01
sara: thanks team — good run. Note: if p99 remains >2x baseline after 30m, we escalate to SEV1. For now continuing monitoring. :thumbsup:
